purpose: Validate that C_orient can be computed from orientation-pattern assignments without topology-class, closure-stability, or campaign-outcome inputs.
governance_note: C_orient is not bridge evidence until all four validation tests pass. Passing VT_001 through VT_004 promotes PO_001 to TESTABLE_PENDING_EXECUTION. OPEN_BRIDGE_001 remains PROVISIONAL_PENDING_RIGOR regardless of C_orient validation outcome.

validation_tests.name: Input Isolation Test
validation_tests.question: Can C_orient be computed before any closure topology is classified?
validation_tests.method: Run C_orient calculation pipeline on chi_D and admissible orientation assignments only; confirm output does not require a prior T_class or closure step.
validation_tests.pass_condition: C_orient output exists using only chi_D and admissible orientation assignments.
validation_tests.fail_condition: Pipeline errors or returns null without topology input.

validation_tests.name: Topology Blindness Test
validation_tests.question: Does C_orient remain unchanged when topology labels are withheld or permuted?
validation_tests.method: Compute C_orient twice: once with T_class labels present in environment, once removed/permuted. Compare outputs.
validation_tests.pass_condition: C_orient values are invariant under removal/permutation of T_class labels.
validation_tests.fail_condition: C_orient values differ when T_class labels change.

validation_tests.name: Closure Stability Blindness Test
validation_tests.question: Does C_orient avoid dependence on S_closure?
validation_tests.method: Compute C_orient with and without S_closure outputs in environment. Compare.
validation_tests.pass_condition: C_orient values are invariant under withholding S_closure outputs.
validation_tests.fail_condition: C_orient values differ when S_closure is withheld.

validation_tests.name: Orientation Shuffling Sensitivity Test
validation_tests.question: Does shuffling orientation assignments lower or decorrelate C_orient under matched chi_D?
validation_tests.method: Matched pairs: (a) coherent orientation assignment, (b) shuffled over same chi_D. Compare C_orient distributions.
validation_tests.pass_condition: Shuffled regimes produce lower or decorrelated C_orient than coherent regimes.
validation_tests.fail_condition: Shuffled and coherent regimes produce indistinguishable C_orient values.

expected_output_artifacts.description: Narrative report of VT_001 through VT_004 results with governed conclusions
Structured audit of C_orient pipeline inputs confirming no topology-class dependency
Per-test pass/fail records with evidence references
Tabular summary of C_orient values under coherent vs shuffled vs topology-blind conditions

all_pass.next_step: Design and execute the full PO_001 campaign comparing C_orient values across orientation regimes

vt_001_fail.note: C_orient candidate form has a structural dependency on topology; metric definition must be revised before any further PO testing

vt_002_or_003_fail.note: C_orient has an implicit dependency on forbidden inputs; implementation or definition must be corrected

vt_004_fail.note: C_orient is non-circular but insensitive to orientation shuffling; metric may need reformulation for discriminatory power before PO_003 is meaningful

PO_001_not_executed: PO_003 blocked — requires both C_orient and T_class_metric validated
downstream_blocks.OPEN_BRIDGE_001: Remains PROVISIONAL_PENDING_RIGOR regardless of C_orient definition or validation status
